name: config-exists-and-validates
assertion: config.json exists in the skill dir, parses as JSON, declares version 3, and every entry in checks[] has a unique id plus either a non-empty cmd array or kind:'grep-forbid' with a non-empty patterns array.

name: config-is-tailored-to-this-repo
assertion: Every command in config.json checks[] actually resolves in THIS repo — each npm/pnpm script named in a cmd exists in package.json, each binary is installed, and no check references a toolchain the repo does not have (e.g. no tsc gate in a repo without typescript).

name: no-daemon-scripts-remain
assertion: scripts/ contains no continuous-checker*.mjs, start-here-*.mjs, errors-by-type-*.mjs, or lint-auto-fix.mjs, and no *.log files are committed. v3 is one-shot only.

name: check-is-run-in-background
assertion: check.mjs is invoked as a background job, never as a blocking foreground command, and the agent never sleeps or polls waiting for it to finish.

name: locking-is-fail-closed
assertion: When the lock holder's command line cannot be read, check.mjs refuses to start rather than proceeding. A run must never begin on the assumption that an unverifiable lock is stale.

name: partial-coverage-is-declared
assertion: When any gate is skipped by tier or --only, both check.mjs stderr and the report.mjs header state which gates did not run. A bounded run is never presented as full coverage.

name: no-orphans-left-behind
assertion: After check.mjs exits by any path (success, findings, timeout, SIGINT, SIGTERM, crash), no child process survives and both the repo lock and the global lock are released.

name: gates-are-not-bypassed
assertion: Findings are resolved by fixing the code, never by adding @ts-nocheck / @ts-ignore / @ts-expect-error / blanket eslint-disable / blanket biome-ignore, and never by editing check.mjs or deleting a gate from config.json to silence it.

name: report-declares-staleness
assertion: report.mjs compares tracked source mtimes against the run's startedAt and explicitly reports FRESH, STALE (naming changed files), or that git could not be read. It never implies freshness it has not verified.
